What Makes Our Garage Floor Epoxy Different

Most homeowners who've had a bad experience with epoxy will tell you the same story: the floor looked great for a year or two, then the coating started peeling, usually in sheets from the tire contact areas. The culprit almost always comes back to one thing — inadequate surface preparation.

When we prepare a garage floor, we use commercial-grade diamond grinding equipment to mechanically profile the concrete surface. This process removes surface contaminants (oil, grease, curing compounds) and creates thousands of microscopic anchor points for the epoxy to bond to. The result is a coating that becomes part of the concrete, not just a film sitting on top of it.

After grinding, we test moisture vapor transmission. Concrete that's wet or has high MVT will cause even quality epoxy to fail over time. If we detect a moisture issue, we either apply a moisture-mitigation primer or we discuss the issue with you honestly — we won't coat a slab that isn't ready, even if it means rescheduling.

Our Garage Floor Epoxy Process

1

Concrete Inspection & Moisture Test

We inspect for cracks, spalling, and high spots, then measure moisture vapor emission rate (MVER). Cracks and divots are filled before coating begins.

2

Diamond Grinding

Commercial grinder with HEPA vacuum removes contaminants and opens the concrete profile to a CSP-2 or CSP-3 level — the industry standard for epoxy adhesion.

3

Penetrating Primer Coat

100% solids epoxy primer penetrates deeply into the ground concrete. This layer seals off residual moisture and creates a chemical bond layer for the base coat.

4

Base Coat + Full Flake Broadcast

Thick base coat applied, then decorative vinyl flake is broadcast to rejection (full coverage) for the traditional speckled look, or left solid for a single-color finish. You choose from 20+ color options.

5

Urethane or Polyaspartic Topcoat

Clear, satin or gloss topcoat seals in the color and flake, provides UV stability, and creates the chemical-resistant, easy-clean surface. We apply two topcoat layers on premium installs.
